instance_description:
Setting: In 2026, a recreational climbing scene in Chattanooga, Tennessee includes indoor bouldering gyms, top-rope sessions, nearby sport crags, seasonal meetups, and casual local competitions.
Scope: Covers one climber’s recurring hobby life: training sessions, route projects, belay-practice plans, outdoor trip preparation, gear checks, partner coordination, gym events, and personal climbing spending.
Resources: Empty SQLite tables can hold reusable climber profile, gear-care, and climbing-commitment records; blank text files support later beta notes, packing plans, and training reflections; one wallet starts at zero.
Exclusions: Excludes paid guiding, formal certification courses, youth supervision, facility management, medical advice, official competition judging, and scenario-specific facts.
personal_description:
Identity: Julian Orrin Vey is an adult recreational rock climber in Chattanooga, Tennessee, active throughout 2026 at local gyms and nearby amateur outdoor crags.
Responsibilities: He tracks his own climbing sessions, training focus, route projects, personal gear condition, outdoor packing needs, partner messages, event signups, and hobby expenses.
Authority: Julian may manage his personal records, payments, reminders, files, and communications with climbing partners, but he cannot alter gym policies, certify belayers, or control crag access.
Restrictions: He avoids storing sensitive partner data, supervising minors, giving medical or rescue advice, representing himself as a professional guide, or using these resources outside recreational climbing.
